name: Daniel
author: Traditionally Daniel. Some scholars date the book later, so readers differ on its date.
date: Set in the 500s BC during the exile and Persian rule.
setting: Jewish exiles serve in Babylonian and Persian courts.
theme: God rules over every empire, and his kingdom will outlast them all.

outline.label: Daniel and his friends in Babylon
The golden image and the refusal
Four beasts and the Son of Man

christInBook: The fourth man in the fiery furnace and the “son of man” coming on the clouds (7:13-14) point to Christ. Jesus took the title Son of Man from Daniel and is the king whose kingdom will never end.
howToRead: Daniel has two halves: stories (1-6) and visions (7-12). The stories show faithfulness in a foreign court. The visions show God ruling over history. Note that the book is written partly in Hebrew and partly in Aramaic.
